name: code-lists
title: Public-domain reference code lists (NAICS + ICD-10-CM)
description: Two normalised, public-domain classification systems — NAICS 2022 (industry) and ICD-10-CM FY2025 (diagnosis) — flattened to a shared code/title/level/parent/as_of shape. Produced by the code-lists arcform pipeline and published to the open zone.

resources.name: naics
resources.description: NAICS 2022 hierarchy: one row per code, sector (level 1) down to national industry (level 5).

fields.name: code
fields.description: 2–6 digit NAICS code, or a sector range like 31-33.

resources.name: icd10cm
resources.description: ICD-10-CM FY2025 hierarchy: one row per code, 3-char category (level 1) down to full 7-char code (level 5).
